## 2. Test Tier Coverage Architecture

Mapped against `TEST_INFRA.md` category-partitioning and boundary-value specifications:

### Tier 1: Core Feature Verification
- **F1: Absence of Demo Persona Cards**: Verified in `e2e/auth.spec.ts` and `e2e/login.e2e.ts`. Asserts complete elimination of demo persona grids and cards ("Conhecer o sistema", "Professor Paraíba", "Seu Antônio", etc.).
- **F2: Dual Login (Username & Email)**: Verified in `e2e/auth.spec.ts`, `e2e/login.e2e.ts`, and `src/lib/__tests__/loginIdentifier.test.ts`. Asserts input normalization (`.trim().toLowerCase()`), email regex routing, and username regex routing.
- **F3: Registration with Username**: Verified in `e2e/auth.spec.ts`, `src/actions/__tests__/auth.test.ts`, and `src/lib/validations/__tests__/schemas.test.ts`. Validates mandatory unique username definition during sign up.
- **F4: User Provisioning ('paraiba')**: Verified in `src/db/__tests__/create-user.test.ts` and `src/db/__tests__/m1-challenger-empirical.test.ts`. Proves user `paraiba` (password `melhorprofessor`, role `Produtor`) seeds idempotently and supports dual authentication.
- **F9 & F10: RBAC Permissions & Server Guards**: Verified in `src/lib/__tests__/permissions.test.ts` and `src/lib/__tests__/permissionGuard.test.ts`. Full 5 roles × 12 modules matrix verified for `view` and `manage` levels, `PermissionError` class formatting, and `requireModuleAccess` guard.
- **F10: Banking Actions & Balance Engine**: Verified in `src/actions/__tests__/banking.test.ts`. Tests account creation, bank statements, statement line reconciliation (N:M transfers), internal transfer liquidity invariants, and balance mathematics.
- **F10: Session Retrieval & Verification**: Verified in `src/lib/__tests__/session.test.ts`. Tests `getVerifiedSession`, `getCurrentSession`, `getEffectiveOrganizationId`, Better Auth resolution, and demo token fallbacks.

### Tier 2: Boundary Value Analysis & Guard Rails
- Boundary check on username length: 3 to 30 characters, strictly alphanumeric + `._-`.
- Zero and negative balance calculations in banking engine (`calculateAccountEndingBalance` with cents precision).
- Zero and negative internal transfer rejection (`executeInternalTransfer`).
- Role permission boundary: `manage` strictly implies `view`; `none` denies both view and manage.
- Server guard rejection: throwing typed `PermissionError` with Portuguese localization when session role lacks permissions.

### Tier 3: Cross-Module Interactions & Navigation
- Authenticated navigation across core modules verified in `e2e/navigation.spec.ts`:
  - `/contas-a-pagar` (Contas a Pagar)
  - `/contas-a-receber` (Contas a Receber)
  - `/fluxo-de-caixa` (Fluxo de Caixa & Projeções)
  - `/dre` (DRE Agrícola)
  - `/cadastros` (Cadastros Base)
- Mobile viewport navigation (390x844):
  - Bottom navigation bar (`nav.bottom-nav`) items navigation
  - Mobile drawer drawer open (`aside.sidebar.open`) and close via drawer button
